units.english: These <bunks> school students need to reach <destination> by <date> for a historical field trip. The school will pay you <payment>.
units.italian: Questi <bunks> studenti devono arrivare a <destination> entro <date> per una gita scolastica storica. La scuola ti pagherà <payment>.

units.english: The students excitedly rush off your ship, taking pictures of everything they see. The school deposits <payment> into your account.
units.italian: Gli studenti si precipitano giù dalla nave entusiasti, fotografando tutto ciò che vedono. La scuola deposita <payment> sul tuo conto.

units.english: You wish your <passengers> the best of luck on <planet>. After collecting your payment of <payment>, your <passengers> put on their Earth Day hats and leave with their belongings.
